funds.

response.answer: Read how both candidates answered the same question. This compares their stated priorities or proposals; it does not rate the candidates or establish that their claims are true.

card.title: If elected, what issues will you make your own?

responses.quote: Three: refunding taxpayers who were overcharged, modernizing basic services so the government actually works for every community, and line-by-line budget accountability so taxpayer dollars are treated with care. I’ve also pledged to donate 100% of my legislative salary to local nonprofits with measurable impact — because service should mean action, not just talk. My north star is simple: a better Jackson County for all.

Restoring trust: Residents need a reason to believe that county government can work. I will show up and listen to ensure every corner of the county is represented. The Legislature must show it can work toward progress together.

Property tax reform: Our assessment process must be fixed, ensuring that mistakes or procedural errors do not unfairly disadvantage homeowners or businesses who have chosen Jackson County as their home. This is a top priority.

Modern and reliable infrastructure: The county should prioritize transportation so residents can connect to jobs and basic needs. Growth and investment must benefit all communities — including neighborhoods that have historically been overlooked.
